promiseCoverage.description: Promise coverage per UTC day and region (ADR 0030), ascending by day. Days without a quoted offer that carries a destination are omitted, so an empty range gives an empty array. Optional and additive; consumers decode tolerantly and ignore it.

regions.description: The ten regions with most requests that day (ties by region, byte order), most first, then the region other when any region was folded into it.

items.description: One region on one day, in two families of fields. OFFERS-based (ADR 0030; requests, answeredWithPromise, answeredWithinDays) the unit is the offer quoted (DeliveryOfferQuoted), the only offer fact that carries both a region and a promised window; a request answered with no offer is not counted there. REQUEST-based (ADR 0031; requestsAnswered, requestsWithPromise, requestsWithinDays, requestShare) the unit is the request answered, quote or estimate, with or without a promise (DeliveryRequestAnswered). The request-based fields are best effort by design, a bounded loss is tolerated, and they exist only from the day DELIVERY_REQUEST_FACTS_ENABLED was switched on; before that, and while it is off, they are 0 and requestShare is null. Regions are ranked by requestsAnswered, then by requests, then by region; a region with request facts and no offer is listed too.

region.description: The first two characters of the destination postal prefix, or other for the regions folded past the tenth. Never more of the destination than that.

requests.description: The offers quoted for the region that day.

answeredWithPromise.description: Those that carry a promised window (deliverByLatest).

answeredWithinDays.description: Cumulative counts over the documented list of days [1, 2, 3, 5], in that order. A promised day count is the number of local calendar days from the quote day to the day of deliverByLatest in the window's time zone (UTC without one), never below 0.

count.description: The offers (answeredWithinDays) or requests (requestsWithinDays) promised within days days or less (cumulative).

share.description: count / requests for answeredWithinDays, count / requestsAnswered for requestsWithinDays; null when the region had none.

requestsAnswered.description: REQUEST-based (ADR 0031, best effort). The quote and estimate requests answered for the region that day, with or without a promise. 0 when none was recorded.

requestsWithPromise.description: REQUEST-based. Those answered with at least one promised option.

requestsWithinDays.description: REQUEST-based. Cumulative counts over the same list of days [1, 2, 3, 5], in that order, of the requests whose shortest promised day count across the answered options is within days; the share is count / requestsAnswered, null when none was answered.

count.description: The offers (answeredWithinDays) or requests (requestsWithinDays) promised within days days or less (cumulative).

share.description: count / requests for answeredWithinDays, count / requestsAnswered for requestsWithinDays; null when the region had none.

requestShare.description: REQUEST-based. requestsWithPromise / requestsAnswered, the share of answered requests that got a promise; null when requestsAnswered is 0.

400.description: invalid-report-range. from or to is not a date (YYYY-MM-DD), from is after to, or the range exceeds 366 days.

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).

500.description: Unexpected failure (internal-error); the detail never leaks the internal message. A 5xx is never stored for an Idempotency-Key, so the same key can retry.
